description: A 300-year-old ghost suddenly finds herself bound in an unwanted spirit marriageto an 8-year-old boy named Lucian.Though annoyed at first, she can't ignore how pitiful he is, living alone and surviving on nothing but roasted potatoes. She begins secretly taking care of himcooking and doing choresonly to discover something shocking:He can see her.The lonely boy warmly accepts her as his "ghost bride," even giving her the name Ria. As they grow close, he makes a promiseto one day take her as his real bride.But fate separates them.Years later, Lucian returns no longer a helpless child, but the emperor of the empiredetermined to fulfill the promise he made to his ghost bride.+
